key_points: Face: The striking surface of a hammer head.
Peen: The end of a hammer head opposite the face, shaped for the task.
Tang: The part of a blade or chisel handle extending into the handle.
Chuck: The clamp holding a drill bit or driver bit.
Kerf: The width of material removed by a saw cut.
Torque: Twisting force, measured in newton-meters or foot-pounds.
Hardened steel: Steel heat-treated for wear resistance in tool edges.
Ergonomics: Design matching the tool to the human hand and motion.
Calibration: Checking a measuring tool against a known standard.
